newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close higher as Dow firms, brewers gain.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close higher as Dow firms, brewers gain.

text.p: UK shares closed higher for a third straight session on Friday, as a continuing robust performance on Wall Street helped drag the FTSE 100 index of blue chip stocks within striking distance of its record high.

Led by sharp gains in brewers and other stocks which stand to benefit from buoyant consumer spending, the FTSE 100 closed 31.7 points higher at 4,799.5-- not far from its peak of 4,879.0 set on July 4. Gainers were in a four-to-one majority.
A 7.5 percent tumble in British Telecom, after a profit warning from planner merger partner MCI, dampened the day's rise and wiped some 14 points off the FTSE.
